python3 - <<'PY'
import base64
import json
import subprocess
repo = 'repos/organvm-iii-ergon/collaboration-operations-platform'
required_files = [
    'packages/contracts/package.json',
    'packages/contracts/src/index.ts',
    'packages/contracts/src/base.ts',
    'packages/contracts/src/command.ts',
    'packages/contracts/src/query.ts',
    'packages/contracts/src/event.ts',
    'packages/contracts/src/job.ts',
    'packages/contracts/src/enums.ts',
    'packages/contracts/README.md',
    'packages/contracts/scripts/validate-contracts.mjs',
    'packages/contracts/schemas/envelope.command.json',
    'packages/contracts/schemas/envelope.query.json',
    'packages/contracts/schemas/envelope.event.json',
    'packages/contracts/schemas/receipt.json',
    'packages/contracts/schemas/job.json',
    'packages/contracts/schemas/problem.json',
]
for path in required_files:
    payload = subprocess.check_output(['gh', 'api', f'{repo}/contents/{path}'], text=True)
    assert json.loads(payload).get('type') == 'file'
package_meta = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['gh', 'api', f'{repo}/contents/packages/contracts/package.json'], text=True))
package_cfg = json.loads(base64.b64decode(package_meta['content']).decode('utf-8'))
assert package_cfg.get('name') == '@collaboration-operations-platform/contracts'
assert package_cfg.get('scripts', {}).get('validate') == 'node scripts/validate-contracts.mjs'
required_schemas = {
    'packages/contracts/schemas/envelope.command.json': 'CommandEnvelope',
    'packages/contracts/schemas/envelope.query.json': 'QueryEnvelope',
    'packages/contracts/schemas/envelope.event.json': 'EventEnvelope',
    'packages/contracts/schemas/receipt.json': 'ReceiptEnvelope',
    'packages/contracts/schemas/job.json': 'JobEnvelope',
    'packages/contracts/schemas/problem.json': 'ProblemEnvelope',
}
for path, expected in required_schemas.items():
    data = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['gh', 'api', f'{repo}/contents/{path}'], text=True))
    schema = json.loads(base64.b64decode(data['content']).decode('utf-8'))
    assert schema.get('title') == expected
    assert schema.get('type') == 'object'
index_content = base64.b64decode(json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['gh', 'api', f'{repo}/contents/packages/contracts/src/index.ts'], text=True))['content']).decode('utf-8')
for anchor in ['base', 'command', 'query', 'event', 'job', 'enums']:
    assert f"from './{anchor}'" in index_content
print('PASS: DELTA-01 contract scaffold exists with expected files and schema titles')
PY

outcome: DELTA-01 introduced a contracts package with envelope/domain primitives, canonical schema artifacts, and a drift-check script.
